free_tier.stated: none: stored minutes have no Free allowance; storage is prepaid at USD 5 a month for each 1,000 minutes of video storage capacity, and delivery is post-paid at USD 1 per 1,000 minutes delivered
free_tier.notes: 100 stored minutes and 10,000 delivered minutes a month are included with the Pro and Business plans, which are paid plans; the Free plan includes none

per_object_cap.stated: 30 GB per video upload by default
per_object_cap.notes: the page writes 30 GB without naming base 10 or base 2, so bytes stays null; the cap applies to one video file

retention.stated: videos are removed if the Stream subscription is not renewed within 30 days of a cancellation; no other expiry of uploaded videos is stated, and an account cannot upload videos once the total video duration exceeds the purchased storage capacity
retention.notes: the 30 days count from a cancelled Stream subscription, not from the upload or the last view; while the subscription is renewed, no expiry is stated

egress.terms: delivery is post-paid at USD 1 per 1,000 minutes delivered, counted by HTTP requests for video segments or parts of an MP4; bandwidth is included in it with no separate egress fee

interface_detail: the Cloudflare REST API under api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/stream and the Stream page of the dashboard; uploads from a link, a file, TUS or a direct creator upload URL; playback through HLS and DASH manifests, and MP4 downloads generated per video through the /downloads endpoint
tooling: the Cloudflare REST API with an API token, the Cloudflare SDKs (client.stream), the dashboard, and the Workers Stream binding
chaining: none as a byte store: storage is billed by video duration regardless of file size, uploads are video files that Stream re-encodes, and downloads are MP4 files that Stream generates per…

limits.value: storage bought in increments of 1,000 minutes of video at USD 5 a month; no upload once the purchased minutes are used
30 GB per video upload by default
120 videos queued or encoding at once by default

limits_note: storage is metered on video duration rounded up to the second, regardless of file size; delivery is metered on minutes delivered, and client-side preloading and buffering count as delivery

identity_cost.detail: Stream storage is a prepaid purchase, and Cloudflare's billing guide requires a primary payment method to purchase products: a card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, UnionPay), PayPal, or a wallet (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link)

reliability_note: uploads stop once the total video duration exceeds the purchased storage capacity, until more storage is purchased or videos are deleted; after a cancellation, videos are removed if the subscription is not renewed within 30 days
confidence_note: the prices, the Free column of the price table, the upload cap, the encode queue limit and the payment-method requirement are quoted from Cloudflare's pages read on 2026-10-31; no probe, because every use needs a purchase

evidence.quote: | Minutes Stored | — | $5.00 / thousand minutes |

evidence.proved: storage is prepaid in increments of 1,000 minutes at USD 5 a month
evidence.quote: Storage is a prepaid pricing dimension purchased in increments of $5 per month for each 1,000 minutes of video storage capacity.

evidence.proved: 100 stored minutes and 10,000 delivered minutes a month come with the Pro and Business plans
evidence.quote: Or, with a Pro or Business Plan, you get 100 free minutes of video storage and 10,000 minutes of video delivery every month included with your plan.

evidence.proved: Pro and Business are paid plans

evidence.proved: one video upload is capped at 30 GB by default
evidence.quote: By default, a video upload can be at most 30 GB.

evidence.proved: the upload page repeats the 30 GB file cap under its list of supported video formats
evidence.quote: Files must be less than 30 GB, and content should be encoded and uploaded in the same frame rate it was recorded.

evidence.proved: uploads and live streams stop when the purchased storage is used up
evidence.quote: If you run out of storage, you will not be able to upload new videos or start new live streams until you purchase more storage or delete videos.

evidence.proved: delivery is post-paid at USD 1 per 1,000 minutes delivered
evidence.quote: Delivery is a post-paid, usage-based pricing dimension billed at $1 per 1,000 minutes delivered.

evidence.proved: bandwidth is priced inside the delivered-minutes meter, with no separate egress fee
evidence.quote: Bandwidth is already included in "video delivered" with no additional egress (traffic/bandwidth) fees.

evidence.proved: the price table lists no Free allowance for delivered minutes, only USD 1.00 per thousand minutes
evidence.quote: | Minutes Delivered | — | $1.00 / thousand minutes |

evidence.proved: delivery is counted per HTTP request for segments or MP4 parts
evidence.quote: Delivery is counted by HTTP requests for video segments or parts of the MP4.

evidence.proved: uploads go through the API or the dashboard
evidence.quote: You can upload videos using the API or directly on the Stream page of the Cloudflare dashboard.

evidence.proved: large uploads go through upload from a link or TUS
evidence.quote: Be sure to use an upload method like Upload from Link or TUS that handles large files well.

evidence.proved: an MP4 download is generated per video through the /downloads endpoint
evidence.quote: Enable MP4 support by making a POST request to the `/downloads` or `/downloads/default` endpoint.

evidence.proved: a Workers Stream binding exists
evidence.quote: See the full [Workers Stream binding API reference](https://developers.cloudflare.com/stream/manage-video-library/bindings/).

evidence.proved: storage is metered on video duration, not on bytes
evidence.quote: Storage consumption is rounded up to the second of video duration, regardless of file size.

evidence.proved: uploaded videos are re-encoded
evidence.quote: During encoding, Stream re-encodes videos for a maximum of 90 FPS playback.

evidence.proved: uploads are gated by the purchased storage capacity
evidence.quote: An account cannot upload videos if the total video duration exceeds the video storage capacity purchased.

evidence.proved: at most 120 videos queue or encode at once by default
evidence.quote: By default, you can have up to 120 videos queued or being encoded simultaneously.

evidence.proved: preloading and buffering are billed as delivery
evidence.quote: Client-side preloading and buffering is counted as billable delivery.

evidence.proved: a purchase on Cloudflare, prepaid Stream storage among them, needs a primary payment method
evidence.quote: A primary payment method is required to purchase Cloudflare products and services.

evidence.proved: R2 is a separate storage product of the same vendor, not the Stream offer
evidence.quote: Video stored in Stream does not incur additional storage fees from other storage products such as R2.

evidence.proved: ingress and encoding carry no charge
evidence.quote: Ingress (sending your content to us) and encoding are always free.

evidence.proved: stored videos are removed when a cancelled Stream subscription is not renewed within 30 days
evidence.quote: Videos are removed if the subscription is not renewed within 30 days.

evidence.proved: uploads stop once the total video duration exceeds the purchased storage capacity
evidence.quote: An account cannot upload videos if the total video duration exceeds the video storage capacity purchased.

notes: A video product priced by duration: storage at USD 5 a month per 1,000 minutes, prepaid; delivery at USD 1 per 1,000 minutes, post-paid; ingress and encoding free. Cloudflare R2 is a separate storage product of the same vendor.

dead_end.why: no stored minutes on the Free plan: storage is prepaid at USD 5 a month for each 1,000 minutes, and delivery is billed at USD 1 per 1,000 minutes
dead_end.retry_when: if the Free plan gains included stored minutes

binding_note: the Free plan includes no stored minutes, so the prepaid storage increment of 1,000 minutes at USD 5 a month is the first gate; every delivered minute is billed after it
